items.name: Operational
items.description: No threats have been detected. Operations may continue as usual.

items.name: Code Yellow
items.description: Potential internal or external threat detected that may impact operations. Non-essential personnel prepare for possible sheltering.

items.name: Code Blue
items.description: Low-intelligence anomaly containment breach in progress. Combat units respond, others move to shelters.

items.name: Code Superblue
items.description: High-intelligence anomaly containment breach in progress. Combat units engage, non-combatants evacuate to shelters.

items.name: Code Red
items.description: Large-scale threat or LSA breach detected. Non-essential personnel evacuate and critical containment protocols activate.

items.name: Code Orange
items.description: Class-D riot or containment breach underway. Zone lockdown initiated; inmates secured before evacuation.

items.name: Code Black
items.description: Non-terminable threat or extreme emergency detected. Essential personnel evacuate under priority protocols.

items.name: Code Green
items.description: Biohazard threat or contaminated anomaly detected. Evacuate affected areas and use hazmat protection.

items.name: Code White
items.description: Hostile group raid in progress. Combat personnel defend; others seek immediate safety.

items.name: Code Gray
items.description: Unauthorized or rogue personnel detected inside the facility. Security forces locate and neutralize the threat.

items.name: Code Silver
items.description: Organized hostile heist detected within the facility. Combat personnel respond and secure critical assets while others evacuate or take cover.

items.name: Code Magenta
items.description: Dimensional or reality-breaking threat detected. Immediate full evacuation required.

items.name: Code Purple
items.description: Cognitohazard or infohazard breach confirmed. Avoid perception and suppress sensory input.

items.name: Code Omni
items.description: Total facility abandonment ordered, overriding all other codes. Full lockdown initiates as final failsafe.

items.name: Purge Protocol
items.description: Last-resort directive to eliminate all personnel within the facility. Activated only under extreme circumstances to ensure total threat neutralization.

items.name: Full Site Lockdown
items.description: Entire facility is sealed with all access restricted. Movement is heavily limited while security protocols are enforced.

items.name: Offline
items.description: Facility systems are non-operational or disconnected. Communication and automated functions are unavailable.
